name.es-ES: Constituciones, Visita de descalzas, Avisos y otros opúsculos
name.en-US: Constitutions, Visitation of the Nunneries, Maxims and other short works
name.pt-BR: Constituições, Visita das descalças, Avisos e outros opúsculos

description.es-ES: Los escritos breves de Santa Teresa para el gobierno de sus monjas y para sus amigos: las Constituciones (1567), el Modo de visitar los conventos de las Carmelitas Descalzas, los Avisos, la Respuesta a un desafío espiritual, el Vejamen y los Pensamientos y sentencias. Un capítulo por pieza; texto crítico del P. Silverio de Santa Teresa, con sus notas.
description.en-US: St. Teresa's short writings for the government of her nuns and for her friends: the Constitutions (1567), the Manner of Visiting the Convents of Discalced Carmelites, the Maxims, the Reply to a Spiritual Challenge, the Vejamen and the Thoughts and Sayings. One chapter per piece; P. Silverio de Santa Teresa's critical text with his notes (Spanish only).
description.pt-BR: Os escritos breves de Santa Teresa para o governo das suas monjas e para os amigos: as Constituições, o Modo de visitar os conventos, os Avisos, a Resposta a um desafio espiritual, o Vejamen e os Pensamentos e sentenças.

sources.edition: Obras de Sta. Teresa de Jesús, ed. P. Silverio de Santa Teresa, C.D., t. VI: Opúsculos (Biblioteca Mística Carmelitana), Burgos: El Monte Carmelo, 1919, pp. 5–125. Princeton Theological Seminary scan, primary OCR.
sources.description: Spanish critical text with Silverio's notes kept as footnotes; his introduction and appendices are not included. OCR of two independent scans merged word by word.
sources.tierEvidence: Teresa died in 1582; the volume was published in 1919 (public domain in the US) and P. Silverio died in 1954, so his notes are public domain under life+70 since 1 January 2025.

sources.edition: The same volume, Wellesley College scan, used as the second witness.
